ValidationRule.description: Requires Root Cause, Corrective Action, and Disposition before status can be set to Closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Investigation_Status__c, "Closed"), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Disposition__c)), ISBLANK(Root_Cause__c), ISBLANK(Corrective_Action__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot close complaint without completing Root Cause, Corrective Action (CAPA), and Disposition fields.
